picks.editorial_note: A rare large-dollar federal bet on AI-driven chemistry: ARPA-H's up to $53M award lets an MIT-led team use generative AI to design safer herbicide alternatives, pairing major funding with a concrete real-world application.
picks.title: MIT-led team receives funding to develop next-generation alternatives to modern weed killers

picks.editorial_note: MIT and UBC's WorldParticle model unifies simulation of wildly different physical phenomena—sand, fluids, proteins—under one deep-learning architecture, a genuine advance toward general-purpose scientific AI.
picks.title: A single AI model simulates the behavior of many substances, from sliding sand to folding proteins

picks.editorial_note: CSIRO's AI-based imaging technique independently validated the iconic Event Horizon Telescope black hole image and was published in Nature, lending AI-driven methods new credibility in fundamental physics.
picks.title: New CSIRO technique confirms iconic black hole image

picks.editorial_note: The DOE's release of 'Genesis Agent Skills,' with Fermilab building agentic tools to automate scientific ML workflows, signals a national push to standardize AI practices across the government lab system.
picks.title: ‘Genesis Agent Skills’ release to support innovation across the Genesis Mission

picks.editorial_note: HKUST's MoU with robotics maker Unitree, anchored by a planned joint laboratory, is a significant academia-industry bet on embodied AI and advanced robotics talent pipelines.
picks.title: HKUST and Unitree Sign MoU to Advance Embodied AI and Robotics Collaboration
picks.university: Hong Kong Univ. of Science and Technology

picks.editorial_note: Atos and Inria's strategic alliance to commercialize sovereign AI research—spanning physical AI, agentic AI, robotics, and cybersecurity—reflects Europe's push for technological sovereignty in AI.
picks.title: Atos and Inria enter into a strategic partnership to accelerate the transfer of research into sovereign industrial applications

picks.editorial_note: TUM's new Munich mobility hub, backed by up to €20M in German federal funding, pairs substantial public investment with a concrete autonomous-transport testbed.
picks.title: Autonomous Public Transportation: TUM Opens New DZM Location in Munich

picks.editorial_note: MIT CSAIL and CMU's new 'Workspace Models' memory approach lets robots recall past observations cheaply, addressing a core bottleneck in long-horizon robot learning.
picks.title: A new form of memory helps robots learn complex skills

picks.editorial_note: A Case Western-led, NIH-funded multi-institutional effort to combine satellite imaging, health data, and AI for studying Alzheimer's environmental risk factors pairs significant funding with translational health science.
picks.title: Case Western Reserve-led team to study how the environment contributes to Alzheimer’s and dementia | CWRU Newsroom | Case Western Reserve University

picks.editorial_note: SMU's $4.2M NIST award to build a Digital Twin Technology Lab ties AI and HPC directly to semiconductor manufacturing workforce development, a priority area for US industrial policy.
picks.title: SMU awarded $4.2 million to advance AI-driven manufacturing and workforce training
